edition.authority: Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship; Benno Cardinal Gut, Prefect; Annibale Bugnini, Secretary
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta presentation. The instruction is the second item under the Congregation's acts in this volume and is numbered in three chapters with articles 1-40; its subscription and date of 24 June 1970 stand on printed p. 663.
edition.title: Instructio Calendaria particularia

passages.context: Chapter III, article 36, on solemnities whose festive precept has been removed. It directs that such solemnities be celebrated on the day on which they are inscribed in the general calendar unless under the general norms of the liturgical year and the calendar they must or may be transferred to another day, and allows an episcopal conference to propose another day to the Apostolic See.

passages.context: Chapter I, Normae generales, articles 1-6. Article 2 requires that the Proper of Time be kept entire and take precedence over particular celebrations, forbids any perpetual particular celebration on a Sunday, and keeps the days of Lent, the Octave of Easter and 17-31 December free of particular celebrations except those it names. Article 4 requires theological, historical and pastoral study by a commission, approval by the competent authority, and confirmation by the Congregation, and states that an approved calendar binds all who are held to it and cannot be changed without the assent of the Apostolic See.

passages.context: Chapter II, on particular celebrations and the particular calendar, articles 7-27. Articles 8-12 enumerate what is proper to a region or nation, a diocese, a place, a church and a religious family; articles 13-16 define how national, diocesan and religious calendars are assembled from the general calendar; article 23 governs the joining of proper and universal celebrations; and article 24 states that a proper celebration is inscribed as an obligatory or optional memorial unless particular historical or pastoral reasons stand against it.

work.author: Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship
work.description: The instruction of 24 June 1970 governing the revision of particular calendars and propers under the reformed General Roman Calendar. It fixes what belongs to a national, diocesan, religious, local and church calendar, the grades to be assigned, the proper day of a celebration, patrons and titles, and the treatment of solemnities whose festive precept has been removed.
work.title: Instructio de calendariis particularibus atque Officiorum et Missarum Propriis recognoscendis
